name: MichCon Jamestown Pipeline
researcher_notes: No roster row: the existing Michigan rows are the DTE Michigan Lateral lines, not this one. A Natural Gas Intelligence item from 2008 describes the 16.3 mile, 30 inch Jamestown Pipeline through Ottawa and Kent counties, Michigan, with a cost of $70 million, built for MichCon in the 2008 construction season. It also names a meter station in Hudsonville and a pressure reduction station in Byron Township. MichCon filed its application with the Michigan Public Service Commission in January 2008. Length 26.2 km clears the 25 km rule. The article is from before completion, so operating status is inferred from the 2008 build schedule and not confirmed by a completion notice. Only one source was found, so tier is medium. Owner is MichCon, the Michigan Consolidated Gas Company, a DTE Energy subsidiary. The entity lookup found no existing MichCon entity. Parent was left blank because no source in hand states it. Route not researched. Next step is a Michigan Public Service Commission order for the case and a start and end point for the route.
